description: Literature review of the foundations of the topic and its bibliography (background stage)

Implement constants.py: Defines global constants for file paths, experiment hyperparameters (lr, gamma, epsilon, episodes), and seeds to ensure reproducibility.. Implement every name its interface declares: its constants.

Implement environment.py: Implements the Tic-Tac-Toe game logic, state representation (numpy array), move validation, and win/draw detection.. Implement every name its interface declares: TicTacToeEnv, TicTacToeEnv.__init__, TicTacToeEnv.reset, TicTacToeEnv.step, TicTacToeEnv.get_legal_moves.
Unit tests of TicTacToeEnv from environment.py in tests/test_environment.py, through the declared interface only.

Implement agents.py: Implements the Q-Learning agent with tabular storage and epsilon-greedy strategy, and a Random Agent class for baseline comparisons.. Implement every name its interface declares: QLearningAgent, QLearningAgent.__init__, QLearningAgent.act, QLearningAgent.update, QLearningAgent.get_q_table, RandomAgent, RandomAgent.act.
Unit tests of QLearningAgent, RandomAgent from agents.py in tests/test_agents.py, through the declared interface only.

Implement figures.py: Reads train_log.csv and results.csv to generate learning curves and win-rate comparison charts in the figures directory.. Implement every name its interface declares: generate_figures.

Implement experiment.py: Runs training and evaluation episodes for both Q-Learning and Baseline agents, logging per-episode rewards to train_log.csv and final metrics to results.csv.. Implement every name its interface declares: run_experiment.
Chapter 1 (Wprowadzenie do uczenia ze wzmocnieniem) in thesis.md: Definicje Markov Decision Process, pojęcia state, action, reward i funkcji wartości.
Chapter 2 (Metoda Q-Learning) in thesis.md: Równanie Bellmana, algorytm aktualizacji wag epsilon-greedy, konwergencja w MDP.
Chapter 3 (Modelowanie gry w kółko i krzyżyk) in thesis.md: Reprezentacja stanu planszy jako tensora NumPy, przestrzeń stanów i akcji, detekcja końca gry.
Chapter 4 (Konfiguracja eksperymentu) in thesis.md: Uzasadnienie hiperparametrów (lr, gamma, epsilon), budżetu treningu, liczby powtórzeń oraz wyboru agenta losowego jako baselina.
Chapter 5 (Wyniki symulacji) in thesis.md: Wykresy uczenia się (krzywe zbieżności), analiza macierzy wygranych vs losowy przeciwnik, kryterium sukcesu.
Chapter 6 (Wnioski i dyskusja) in thesis.md: Ocena osiągniętej strategii, ograniczenia tabelarycznego podejścia w większych grach.

Implement environment.py with a corrected interface that fixes the logical contradictions in the previous doctests. The core change is to simplify `get_legal_moves` to return all empty cells regardless of the `player` argument (as the game state determines validity, not player identity), and ensure `step` correctly alternates turns. Specifically: 1) Remove the `player` argument check inside `get_legal_moves` which caused the doctest failure (`len(moves_after) == 8` expected True but got False because turn had switched). 2) Fix `step` to update `_turn` correctly after a move is played. 3) Correct `_is_terminal` logic: X (-1) wins if it has 3 in a row, O (0) wins if it has 3 in a row. Ensure `reset` sets `_turn = -1`. The code must pass the provided doctests which assume standard Tic-Tac-Toe rules.

Implement generate_figures() to plot learning curves from train_log.csv and compare results from results.csv into figures/. The previous attempt failed due to pandas index/column resolution errors when reading the CSVs generated by experiment.py. Specifically, experiment.py writes `results.csv` without an index (so columns are 'method', 'metric', 'value'), but the code tried to use column names as index or expected a MultiIndex that didn't exist. Also, train_log.csv is written with default integer index, not dates. Fix 1: Read train_log.csv with default index (integers) and plot episode vs reward directly. Fix 2: Pivot results.csv correctly by grouping by method and metric to compare Q-Learning vs Random_Baseline rates. Use `matplotlib.use('Agg')` and save to FIGURES_DIR.

Implement generate_figures() to plot learning curves from train_log.csv and compare results from results.csv into figures/. Previous attempts failed because they did not handle the specific column structures generated by experiment.py correctly or relied on missing imports (np). 1) Read train_log.csv. It has columns 'run', 'episode', 'reward'. Pivot or groupby to get mean reward per episode across runs, then plot episode vs mean reward using matplotlib. 2) Read results.csv. It has columns 'method', 'metric', 'value'. Filter for metrics 'win_rate_vs_random', 'draw_rate_vs_random', 'loss_rate_vs_random'. Plot a grouped bar chart comparing Q-Learning and Random_Baseline for these metrics. Ensure numpy is imported as np before use. Save to FIGURES_DIR.
